mapper.select: select item_type, item_id, created_at from user_favorites where user_id = #{userId} and item_type = #{itemType} order by created_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into user_favorites(user_id, item_type, item_id) values (#{userId}, #{itemType}, #{itemId})
mapper.delete: delete from user_favorites where user_id = #{userId} and item_type = #{itemType} and item_id = #{itemId}
